regime_context: The detector shows a broad, healthy dual-leadership structure (Base Metals & Copper ranked 1, Oil & Gas Production ranked 2, margin only 0.11) with 9 of 16 themes eligible — a non-one-narrative, non-directional rotation state. The only validated edge is the absolute-trend gate for drawdown control; momentum rank is a focus lens with near-zero rank-IC, and gate_helps is true for this market, so low-conviction, trend-discipline framing is appropriate.
emerging_watch: Watching Big Banks (ZEB.TO) — the lone 'trend' hurst_tag among top-5 eligible themes with a positive score (0.7) but weak breadth (0.286). If breadth expands above 0.4 while remaining eligible, the trend tag would be supported and the watch could graduate to a lean; if ZEB.TO breaks below its own 50-day average for a week, the watch is retired.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: The leader theme is eligible via the absolute-trend gate (the one validated leg), has the highest score, broad breadth (0.556, strongest among the top themes), and no crowding flag. However, its hurst_tag is mean-revert and the momentum rank itself is not alpha — so the lean is a trend-discipline expression (stay with the eligible leader unless the gate fails), not a return forecast.
evidence: breadth=0.556, the highest among ranked themes
durability_bar=0.5 ties with the rotation leader role
theses.dissent: Hurst tag is mean-revert, and with rank-IC near zero the leadership could simply reflect recent commodity tape rather than durable trend; a mean-reversion pullback would undercut the leader without any detector warning.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO closes below its 50-day average and stays there for a full trading week before the check-by date

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: The challenger is eligible under the trend gate with the second-highest score and the narrowest gap to the leader (margin 0.11). It carries the highest durability_bar (0.61) and breadth (0.571) in the dataset, and is not crowded. The lean is a conditional stay-with-strength view supported by the gate leg, with no claim of handoff.
evidence: durability_bar=0.61, highest of any eligible theme
theses.dissent: Hurst tag is mixed, and a 0.11 margin is statistically indistinguishable — leadership could as easily revert to Base Metals or fade to a third theme, making any directional pick between top two near-coin-flip.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO underperforms XBM.TO by more than 3% over any rolling 10-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology is the only theme flagged crowded (crowding_z=1.16, crowded=true) alongside a negative score. Per the guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution and never a short — so the lean is 'avoid' (no new overweight), not a fade. The negative score and crowded flag together argue against initiating exposure here.
evidence: crowded=true, crowding_z=1.16 (only crowded theme in the set)
guardrails do_not_conclude: crowding is a size-down caution, never a fade
theses.dissent: Technology has the second-highest breadth (0.5) among non-leaders and its score is only mildly negative; crowding alone has no basket-level forward edge, so an avoid lean could miss continued participation if the broad tape stays healthy.

falsifier.text: XIT.TO outperforms the S&P/TSX benchmark by more than 4% between now and the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
